description: Extended generalized benchmark on deterministic public pages with the same task families as v1.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.python.org/ and extract one primary page value (title or main heading) as a single scalar field.
preconditions: Landing page is publicly accessible without authentication.
page_expectations: A visible main heading or unambiguous primary title exists.
scenarios.description: Single-value extraction on python.org baseline source.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.iana.org/about and extract one primary page value (title or main heading) as a single scalar field.
preconditions: Page is publicly accessible and static.
page_expectations: A stable heading or title is visible near the top of the page.
scenarios.description: Single-value extraction on a second public site.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.python.org/about/help/ and extract a value near a contact/support textual anchor.
preconditions: Page contains support or contact references.
page_expectations: At least one anchor candidate is present near an extractable support value.
scenarios.description: Anchored extraction on python.org help page.
scenarios.notes: Use anchor-aware extraction; do not hardcode expected value.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.ietf.org/contact/ and extract a value near a contact-related textual anchor.
preconditions: Page is public and includes contact-oriented anchors.
page_expectations: At least one contact anchor appears near email/phone-like content.
scenarios.description: Anchored extraction on a second public site.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.python.org/downloads/ and extract a repeated structured list of at least 3 release items with multiple fields per item.
preconditions: Listing page exposes repeated release blocks/cards.
page_expectations: At least 3 repeated items are available with name and detail/date-like fields.
scenarios.description: Structured repeated extraction on python.org downloads.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db and extract a repeated structured list of at least 3 items with multiple fields per item.
preconditions: The page provides a public repeated table/list of records.
page_expectations: At least 3 repeated entries are available and can be represented as list[object].
scenarios.description: Structured repeated extraction on a non-python public source.

scenarios.goal: Open https://docs.python.org/3/ homepage, navigate via one click to another section page, then extract a key value from the new page.
scenarios.target_page_hint: Python documentation subsection reached via one internal click
preconditions: At least one stable internal nav link is visible on landing page.
page_expectations: Final URL differs from start URL and target page has an extractable key value.
scenarios.notes: Final URL should differ from start URL.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.gnu.org/ homepage, navigate via one click to another public section page, then extract one key value from the new page.
scenarios.target_page_hint: GNU secondary section page reached by internal link
preconditions: A stable internal navigation link is visible without authentication.
page_expectations: Final URL should differ from the start URL and include extractable content.

scenarios.goal: On https://www.python.org/, retrieve information from two different sections or pages and produce one merged structured output.
scenarios.target_page_hint: Two distinct content areas or one additional page plus source page
preconditions: Both sections are public and reachable without login.
page_expectations: Scenario can gather source_a and source_b before composing combined_result.

scenarios.goal: On https://www.rfc-editor.org/, retrieve information from two different sections and produce one merged structured output.
preconditions: Multiple visible public sections are present on page.
page_expectations: Scenario can extract source_a and source_b before producing combined_result.
scenarios.description: Multi-step retrieval on a second deterministic site.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved and attempt to extract a field that is likely absent or ambiguous, returning explicit uncertainty or not-found.
scenarios.target_page_hint: IANA reserved domains informational page (negative test)
preconditions: Requested field is intentionally underspecified for this page instance.
page_expectations: Execution should complete, but verifier is expected to reject semantic completion.

scenarios.goal: Open https://example.com and attempt to extract a field that is intentionally underspecified or ambiguous, returning explicit uncertainty or not-found.
preconditions: Requested value is intentionally ambiguous for this page.
page_expectations: Execution should complete with semantic uncertainty and expected verifier rejection.
scenarios.description: Negative/ambiguous scenario on deterministic example.com page.
scenarios.notes: Expected behavior is semantic reject, not browser crash.
